item.title: Taking a taxi from the airport
item.context_text: You land at an airport in a new country in the evening. You need a taxi to your hotel. Your mum is waiting for a message from you.
item.objective_text: Find the official taxis, tell the driver your address, understand him, and send a message home.
item.target_grammar: present continuous for now (I am in the taxi now.)
item.cultural_note: At many airports it is safer to use the official taxi rank. Show the driver the hotel address on your phone if he doesn't understand.
success_conditions: Find where the official taxis are
Give the driver the hotel name and address
Tell your mum where you are and when you arrive

children.title: Read the hotel information
children.instructions: Read the information from your hotel. Then answer the questions.
children.prompt_text:
City Star Hotel
12 Park Road
From the airport: about 30 minutes by taxi.
Please use the official taxis at the yellow sign, Exit B.

options: At the yellow sign, Exit B
questions.explanation: "Please use the official taxis at the yellow sign, Exit B."

questions.prompt: How long is the taxi ride?
questions.explanation: "From the airport: about 30 minutes by taxi."

children.title: Talk to the driver
children.instructions: You get into the taxi. Tell the driver where you want to go. Give the hotel name and the address.
children.goal: Give the driver the hotel name and address.
children.model_answer: Hello. To the City Star Hotel, please. It is at 12 Park Road.

children.title: Listen to the driver
children.instructions: Listen to the driver. Then answer the questions. You can listen again.
children.prompt_text: OK, Park Road. No problem. It's about thirty minutes now, because there is not much traffic. You can pay by card in the taxi. Can I put your bag in the car for you?

questions.explanation: The driver says "You can pay by card in the taxi."

questions.prompt: What does the driver say about the traffic?
options: There is a lot of traffic
questions.explanation: He says "there is not much traffic".

children.title: Message your mum
children.instructions: Your mum sends you a message. Write back. Say you are OK, you are in a taxi, and when you arrive at the hotel.
children.prompt_text: Mum: Did you land? Are you OK?
children.goal: Tell your mum you are fine, in a taxi, and when you arrive.

points.label: say you are in a taxi

children.model_answer: Yes, Mum, I am fine! I am in a taxi now. The hotel is thirty minutes from the airport. I can call you from the hotel.
